warehouse-front.subject: front of a corrugated steel rail freight warehouse: its grey front gable end with a RAIL FREIGHT sign, three dock doors and a man door, and its tan right side wall with a high band of windows

warehouse-rear.subject: back of the same warehouse: its grey back gable end with three dock doors, and its tan right side wall with a high band of windows

loading-platform.subject: raised concrete rail loading platform with a steel canopy on five posts, yellow edge stripes and steps at one end

gantry-crane.subject: yellow rail-mounted gantry crane with a box girder, a hoist trolley and hook, and an operator cab on one leg
